pages.text: Your first star ingot unlocks sword and guide recipes plus clickable chat help. Obtaining the sword grants a Patchouli guide once per player/world. Death and reconnects do not duplicate gifts. guide.autoGift disables gifts.
Use /astral help for controls or /astral stats for counters. All keys can be rebound. The current Patchouli guide is retained instead of restoring the old written book.$(br2)guide.autoGift
